audit.whatIsWrong: This page's chart read Skill/Skill/Skill/Gangplank/Skill/Gangplank/Gangplank in both layers. The already-audited mirror (gangplank__sett) settled the chart as Gangplank/Skill/Sett/Sett/Skill/Sett/Gangplank, and the packet chart reads Sett on rows 0-5 with Gangplank late.
audit.why: Two directions of the same matchup must not disagree — mirror-fix.js would overwrite this side anyway. The mirror's read also matches the kits: Parrrley outranges Sett at 625 with a 4.5s cooldown so level 1 is Gangplank's, and from level 3 Facebreaker pulls him off kegs until his crit items land.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2, 3 and 5 flipped to match the mirror in both layers as one atomic group, ratings moved with them, and every why-string rewritten so no row claims 'yours' on a row the enemy owns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet's only defect is 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' — not one real cooldown number appeared on the page, so every spike read as a mood rather than a window.
audit.why: Facebreaker is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s, Remove Scurvy is 22/20/18/16/14s, The Show Stopper is 120/100/80s. Those numbers are what turn 'deny his barrels' into an actual instruction.
audit.corrected: Facebreaker's 13s at rank 3 keyed to the keg-denial spike, Remove Scurvy's 16s to the anti-heal window, and R's 120s to the level-6 all-in.

audit.whatIsWrong: Haymaker was written as uniformly heavy damage with no mention that only the centre is true damage, and Remove Scurvy's limits were left vague ('before he can cleanse and kite').
audit.why: Riot's Sett W text splits the panel: true damage in the centre, physical on the sides — so where Gangplank stands during the cash is the single biggest damage decision in the lane. Riot's Remove Scurvy text is 'cure crowd control effects and restore Health'; the mirror recorded that it does not free him from The Show Stopper, and both sides now state that identically.
audit.corrected: Centre-the-target instruction added to the level-6 spike and the 2+ items line; the R-versus-Remove-Scurvy limit restated from the mirror's wording rather than re-derived.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both applicable missing interactions were absent: Gangplank sustains through chip with Remove Scurvy, and Cannon Barrage deals true damage so stacking resistances is the wrong answer.
audit.why: Sett's whole plan is repeated melee chip; without Grievous Wounds that chip is refunded on a 16s cooldown. And the standard 'he's fed, buy armour' reflex does nothing against a true-damage ult.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal timing added to the itemization line and the first-item spike; the resistances point added to the late/2+ items text.

edits.before: Double-punch passive makes you the strongest level-1 auto-trader in the lane. Punish Gangplank on every CS, but respect his opening tool — chips now, all-ins later.
edits.after: Gangplank pokes from 625 range with Parrrley on a 4.5s cooldown and you have no answer at level 1. Eat the chip, hold the wave near you, and wait for Facebreaker.

edits.before: Q ranks make your punch trades heavier, but Gangplank has his core tools too. Keep the grit bar honest: trade in, W-shield his return damage, out.
edits.after: Q ranks make your punch trades heavier and Facebreaker is 13s at rank 3 — pull him off every keg he plants near you, then cash W with him dead-centre.

edits.before: Stridebreaker fixes your only weakness — sticking to Gangplank. Shove, recall on the spike, and force the next trade before he matches your item.
edits.after: Stridebreaker fixes your only weakness — sticking to Gangplank. Force trades now, and buy Grievous Wounds or Remove Scurvy refunds the chip every 16s.

edits.before: Sterak's makes your all-in nearly unburstable. Fights are decided by whether you cash a max-grit W — track Powder Kegs and commit on the gap.
edits.after: Sterak's makes your all-in nearly unburstable, but Cannon Barrage is true damage — armour and MR buy nothing. End it before his crit items land.

edits.before: Level 1 is yours — forcing melee denies his Q farming and barrel stacking.
edits.after: Level 1 is his — Parrrley pokes from 625 range and you cannot answer.

edits.before: Level 2 stays yours as your E-Q trade beats his walk-ups.
edits.after: Level 2 evens out once Q double-punch punishes his walk-ups.

edits.before: Level 6 your R all-in beats him before his cleanse-and-kite.
edits.after: Level 6 your R commits him — Remove Scurvy cannot break it.

edits.before: Your R The Show Stopper burst plus Grit Haymaker all-ins him before he can W Remove Scurvy your slow and kite; slam him and he can't out-trade a committed Sett in melee range.
edits.after: The Show Stopper (120s) carries him off his kegs and Remove Scurvy will not free him from it; land him in your wave, then cash Haymaker with him dead-centre for the true damage.

edits.before: Keep denying barrel setups — E-pull him whenever he places a keg near you so the chain never detonates, and out-sustain his Q poke on Grit through the early item timing.
edits.after: Keep denying barrel setups — Facebreaker (13s) drags him off a keg before the chain detonates, and buy Grievous Wounds early or Remove Scurvy (16s) heals him out of every trade.

edits.before: Once Gangplank has Trinity/Essence Reaver crit online, his barrel-chain burst plus R Cannon Barrage global pressure and self-peel let him kite and one-combo you from range — a scaled GP out-damages your walk-up kit.
edits.after: Once Gangplank has Trinity/Essence Reaver crit online, barrel chains plus Cannon Barrage burst you from range — and the ult's true damage means stacking armour or MR buys you nothing. A scaled GP out-damages your walk-up kit.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are yours — pressure Gangplank in melee so he can't comfortably Q-last-hit or place kegs; every time he walks up you land your E Facebreaker plus Q slow trade for free.
edits.after: Level 1 is his — Parrrley chips you from 625 range for free, so hold the wave near you and farm. From 2 your Q double-punch punishes every walk-up he makes to plant a keg.

edits.before: Through 3-6 you keep him off his barrels: E-pull him whenever he sets a Powder Keg near you, out-sustain his Q on Grit, and at 6 your R slam plus Haymaker all-in beats him before he can cleanse and kite.
edits.after: Through 3-6 you keep him off his barrels: Facebreaker (13s) drags him off a keg before it chains, and at 6 The Show Stopper carries him away — Remove Scurvy cleanses CC, but not that.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + Health Potion  (vs his poke). Core: Stridebreaker  (stick to them through the W panel window), then Sterak's Gage; boots Plated Steelcaps. First back: Phage / Tiamat + boots (≈1300g).
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + Health Potion (vs his poke). Core: Stridebreaker, then Sterak's Gage; boots Plated Steelcaps. Buy Executioner's Calling early — Remove Scurvy heals him out of your chip. First back: Phage + boots (≈1300g).

notes: Chart now matches the mirror exactly (Gangplank/Skill/Sett/Sett/Skill/Sett/Gangplank) in both layers. The mirror's note that the full layer never uses real ability names outside Haymaker holds on this side too — Facebreaker and The Show Stopper appear only in the content layer and in the phase whys I rewrote; the dosFull/dontsFull/report blocks still say 'E-stun' and 'W panel'. I did not rewrite those wholesale this pass. Separately: Sett's E only stuns with enemies on opposite sides, so in a 1v1 lane it is a slow — the phrase 'E-stun' in tradeGood, dosFull[1] and breakdown.trading is inaccurate here and on every other Sett page using the same boilerplate.
